name: HORM
short: An Italian furniture house established in 1989, pairing traditional craftsmanship with leading international designers to create contemporary pieces of quiet, elegant presence.
long:
HORM is an Italian furniture house established in 1989, producing high-end contemporary pieces for private and contract spaces. It combines traditional Italian craftsmanship with an ongoing dialogue between material, function and form, in collaboration with renowned international designers.

The collections are marked by precision, innovation and fine materials, in search of elegant, restrained solutions: furniture with real design depth and an understated presence. Over the years the house has earned wide international recognition, working across the Horm, Casamania and Orizzonti Italia labels.
